Cmyk = object
  c*, m*, y*, k*, a*: float  ## 0..1
Color = object
  r*, g*, b*, a*: float      ## sRGB 0..1, alpha 0..1
  format*: ColorFormat
  valid*: bool
ColorFormat = enum
  cfHex, cfRgb, cfHsl, cfHsv, cfHsb, ## alias of hsv
  cfCmyk, cfLab, cfLch, cfOklab, cfOklch, cfNamed, cfHwb
Hsb = Hsv

Hsv = object

  s*, v*, a*: float
Hwb = object

Lab = object

  alpha*: float
Lch = object

Oklch = object
